title: The Jolene Bubbly Bar with Views 5min to DT
description:
The Ultimate Group accommodation in Nashville!  Completely themed to the Queen of Country, Dolly herself.  This unique home includes a top floor "Bubbly Bar" with Nashville skyline views, multiple custom murals - perfect for your group pics, 7 beds, and professional design...  All within 10 minutes of Broadway!   

Free parking, Free WiFi + Free Netflix + Free Coffee & more!

The space
"The White Limozene " - 1 Queen bed (memory foam mattress)
"The 9 to 5" -  3 Queen beds (memory foam mattresses) + Makeup Vanity
"The Jolene" -  2 Twin beds (memory foam mattresses)
 "The Diamond" -  Media room w/ 1 Full pullout bed

Perks:

▶︎ Third floor "Champagne Bar" with downtown skyline views
▶︎ Common area with multiple murals and photo opps!
▶︎ Free parking
▶︎ Hi-speed Internet
▶︎ Washer + Dryer available for use
▶︎ Soft, clean linens for each bed
▶︎ Fresh towels, shampoo, body wash and hair dryer provided
▶︎ 5 minute uber to Broadway hotspots

STR Permit # is listed in photo caption

Guest access
There is one driveway spot, as well as free street parking.

Other things to note
Literally minutes to all the best of Nashville!  Recommendations for restaurants and music venues available upon request.

If you love this listing but your dates are unavailable, check the sister properties next door - airbnb.com/h/dollydreamhouse or airbnb.com/h/thelegends

Please note, this house is attached to its sister property, "Dolly's Dream House," and shares the common area with one additional property.  Guests are kindly asked to be respectful to other guests and adhere to the quiet hours.

While we do love pets, unfortunately we cannot allow them in the home.  Smoking and parties are also prohibited.
